name: next_back_unchecked
declaration: unsafe fn next_back_unchecked (& mut self) -> (& 'a K , & 'a mut V)
parent: Handle < NodeRef < marker :: ValMut < 'a > , K , V , marker :: Leaf > , marker :: Edge >
documentation:
Moves the leaf edge handle to the previous leaf and returns references to the
 key and value in between.

 # Safety
 There must be another KV in the direction travelled.
rules: For safety, when calling next_back_unchecked, there must be another key-value pair in the backward direction from the current leaf edge handle.
